contract.intent: Make the companion operating guide ann's living contract: keep it durable (committed, locked artifact) and make it a goal leg in ann's own journey, so the look-back can check how ann is doing against its promises.
acceptanceCriteria: Guide kept: the companion guide is a committed, locked artifact in this leg (real file under the leg's artifacts/, type record, sha recorded) — re-locked as a new version whenever it changes
Gaps tracked: every §3 gap in the guide maps to a task in this journey (open or done) — no gap is silent; the mapping is visible in the journey
Log-protectors landed: terminal freeze, gate rationale, and native correction flow each complete as a done task under this leg, with check + verify staying clean as evidence

Look-back works: ann journey 08-companion-operating + check + verify report ann's fitness — green, or naming exactly what is off — so a periodic review can check how ann is doing directly from the journey
Dogfooding holds: this leg is managed through ann (spawned, gated, locked via CLI; no hand-edited events), with rationale recorded at its gates
expectedOutputs: log-protector tasks (terminal freeze, gate rationale, correction flow)
